data.name: Autocrats
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap

Autocrats is currently in development. Updates to the game will be released as a demo and for free on Steam. You can support the game by adding it to your wishlist and following the game. You can also share your feedback on our Discord server and Reddit subreddit.


About the Game

Autocrats, First-Person Government Simulation Game

Establish your own nation and rule like an autocrat. Work for the well-being of your citizens or wage war for global hegemony.

Assignment

Rising from the ashes of global crises, humanity has united under the World Republic. With its wounds healed, this new union set its sights on the stars, accelerating its space colonization efforts. Soon Earth-like planets were discovered, Mora one of them. By order of the World Republic, you have been tasked with establishing a colony on this new world and building the future of humanity.

Gameplay

The game features two modes: First-Person and Government. You can switch between these modes. Both are used to establish, develop, and govern your nation.

  • First-Person Mode: Construct your nation's buildings with your own hands, search for resources in uncharted territories, and lay the foundations for new settlements.

  • Government Mode: Enact laws for your country, direct the economy, engage in diplomatic relations, and lead your army to victory. Every decision has consequences.

Mora

Beyond its human colonies, Mora is home to vast, wild, and untouched lands teeming with resources. Exploring these territories is as dangerous as it is rewarding. Before venturing outside the safe borders of your colony, make sure to stock up on vital supplies.

Key Features

  • Explore & Build in First-Person: Experience the world directly from a first-person perspective.

  • Government Simulation: Manage economics, diplomacy, laws, and your society.

  • Boundless Open World: Discover the dangerous and rich lands of MORA.

  • Strategic City-Building: Design and expand your cities and colonies from scratch.

  • Resource & Production Management: Create supply chains for the prosperity of your people and the might of your army.

  • Military Strategy: Raise, equip, and command your army in wars against other powers.
